skills.name: arwp-growth-loop
skills.description: Evidence-backed ongoing website growth loop for Search, recommendations, generative Search, AI citations and agent readability: research, hypothesize, implement, verify and measure.

skills.name: arwp-search-maturity
skills.description: Reverse-engineer timestamped observable patterns from currently visible independent Search/AI reference pages, compare repeated cohort patterns with a target site and route grounded gaps into experiments without treating correlations as ranking factors.

skills.name: arwp-adaptive-upgrade
skills.description: Compile a target site's current Growth evidence into source-backed upgrade recipes with exact change surfaces, verification contracts, measurement signals and knowledge-freshness gates.

skills.name: arwp-target-transformation
skills.description: Resolve adaptive upgrade recommendations to exact target-repository files and deliver deterministic, digest-gated production changes through local rollback-aware application or a new GitHub PR.

skills.name: arwp-prepare-site
skills.description: End-to-end repository preparation for ARWP, search quality, AI-search/citation readiness and agent interoperability.

skills.name: arwp-ai-search-content
skills.description: Improve articles, docs, comparisons and answer pages for human usefulness, retrieval and citation without AI filler or ranking promises.

skills.name: arwp-future-search
skills.description: Prepare healthy sites for emerging Search/AI/agent systems using governed future-ready semantics, semantic/evidence graphs, retrieval feedback and browser-agent operability beyond today's documented rich-result requirements.

skills.name: arwp-dataset-publication
skills.description: Audit and prepare genuine website corpora for versioned dataset releases, checksums, external archival publication and DOI-backed citation.

skills.name: arwp-agent-discovery
skills.description: Implement truthful agent discovery surfaces such as llms.txt, Agent Skills, ARD, MCP/A2A/OpenAPI and optional ARWP profiles.

skills.name: arwp-evidence-ci
skills.description: Add assertion contracts, scheduled audits, evidence receipts and regression-safe CI.

composition.principle: Use the growth orchestrator to fix current eligibility and evidence-backed priorities first; invoke Search Maturity when a current intent needs a reviewed independent reference cohort; compile accepted site-specific upgrades; invoke Future Search only for grounded reversible semantic/retrieval experiments after foundations are healthy; then use Target Transformation only after exact files and grounded facts are resolved. Policy/editorial/owner/runtime decisions remain gated.
